_README: Webhooks come from the GitHub repo Secret DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions). Leave the fields below empty. Never paste a webhook into this file in a PUBLIC repo.

settings._noise_k_note: Call only if |gap| >= noise_k * sigma_per_min * sqrt(minutes_left). Lowered 1.0 -> 0.85 on Sep 13 2026.
settings._dry_run_note: true = don't post to Discord. The workflow sets this to false automatically when the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL secret exists.
settings._call_marks_note: ONE recorded call per round, at minute 6 (~9 min left), moved from 7 on Sep 13 2026 (Anthony: 'Call at minute 6 instead'). Before that the card shows an EXPECTED lean only, never recorded.
settings._conviction_gate_note: Multiple of the noise band the gap must clear before a directional call. Lowered 1.5 -> 1.15 on Sep 13 2026.
settings._max_call_price_note: No BUY when the side we'd buy already costs more than this. Lowered 0.85 -> 0.65 on Sep 13 2026 (Anthony: 'Stop calling so high ... but we want decent profits'). The direction is still called and recorded; the card says PRICED OUT.
settings._min_edge_points_note: Our win probability must beat the market's implied probability by at least this many points for the call to be tradeable. Added Sep 13 2026.
settings._stretch_price_note: Disabled (0.0) Sep 13 2026: a backtest of the last 116 settled calls showed the 65c cap alone is the only cut that turns paper P&L positive; letting 65-78c back in on edge alone had no support in the data.
